conventions.database_functions: RAISE EXCEPTION '<ERR_ code>' USING ERRCODE = '<sqlstate>'. PostgREST maps the sqlstate to HTTP (28* 403; 42501 403 when authenticated, else 401; P0001 and 22* 400; 23505 409) and returns {code: <sqlstate>, message: <ERR_ code>, details, hint}. Read the ERR_ code from `message`.
conventions.edge_functions: Body {error: {code: <ERR_ code>, request_id?}} with the listed HTTP status; every response carries an x-request-id header.
conventions.auth_hooks: Hook errors go to Supabase Auth, not to apps. Apps receive Supabase Auth error codes and map them (auth-error-mapping.json).
conventions.status: implemented = raised by backend code today (CI-checked); planned = reserved for a documented backend rule, not raised yet; client = produced by the apps only.

codes.description: Attempt to update or delete audit or consent history.
codes.client_action: Never expected; treat as a security incident (RB-07).

codes.description: Phone number outside live or beta countries; raised by the auth hooks. Apps receive a Supabase Auth error instead.
codes.client_action: See auth-error-mapping.json.

codes.description: The device is not registered to this user.
codes.client_action: Call register_device, then request a new nonce.

codes.description: A hook secret is missing in the function environment.
codes.client_action: Ops: RB-10.

codes.description: The first request with this key has not completed.
codes.client_action: Retry the same request with the same key after a short delay.

codes.description: Idempotency key missing or not 16 to 128 characters.
codes.client_action: App bug: generate keys with newIdempotencyKey().

codes.description: The key was already used for a different operation or a different payload.
codes.client_action: App bug: a new user intent needs a new key; only retries reuse one.

codes.description: The integrity nonce is unknown, expired, used, or belongs to someone else.
codes.client_action: Request a fresh nonce and repeat the integrity check.

codes.description: Unhandled server error in an Edge Function; the body carries error.request_id.
codes.client_action: Retry with backoff; show the request id if it persists.

codes.description: A required argument is missing or malformed.
codes.client_action: Treat as an app bug: log with the request id; show a generic retry message.

codes.description: A hook payload failed validation.
codes.client_action: Ops.

codes.description: A basis-point rate outside 0 to 10000.
codes.client_action: Server bug.

codes.description: A webhook failed Standard Webhooks verification.
codes.client_action: Ops: check hook secrets (RB-10).

codes.description: The language is not supported in the user's country.
codes.client_action: Offer only the languages from the country pack.

codes.description: Wrong HTTP method for an Edge Function.
codes.client_action: App bug.

codes.description: The signed-in user has no profile row.
codes.client_action: Sign out and back in; report if it persists.

codes.description: The session id is unknown, already signed out, or belongs to another user.
codes.client_action: Refresh the session list; it is already gone.

codes.description: Provider mode needs completed provider verification.
codes.client_action: Open provider onboarding (PRD SH-08).

codes.description: Every SMS provider failed for this OTP (auth-send-sms hook).
codes.client_action: Apps receive Auth's sms_send_failed; see auth-error-mapping.json.

codes.description: No SMS route or providers configured, or routes unreadable.
codes.client_action: Ops: RB-01.

codes.description: No valid session on a call that needs one.
codes.client_action: Refresh the session; if that fails, send the user to sign-in.

codes.description: A currency code missing from public.currencies.
codes.client_action: Server or configuration bug.

codes.description: The required consent (biometric or criminal-record) is missing or outdated.
codes.client_action: Show the consent screen for that kind.

codes.description: Feature switched off by a flag or not configured (RB-13). Raised by concierge_start when concierge.text is off for the caller's country, and by every Meet v5 client RPC through private.meet_require_access when the Meet flag it needs is off for the caller (meet.v5 testers-only admits private.meet_testers alone, and every meet.* sub-flag also needs meet.v5). Until its own PR lands, a Meet v5 RPC is a skeleton stub that raises this and does nothing else; the catalogue marks those entries not_built. meet_get_state never raises it: with Meet off it returns {v5: false}.
codes.client_action: Hide the entry point; offer the fallback flow. From a Meet function it means Meet v5 is off for this person: show today's meet-ups page. meet_get_state says the same with v5: false.

codes.description: No concierge conversation with that id belongs to the caller.
codes.client_action: Start a new conversation.

codes.description: The job or offer is not in a state that allows this action.
codes.client_action: Reload the job; its state changed.

codes.description: Withdrawal exceeds the available balance.
codes.client_action: Reload the wallet.

codes.description: The request or job is not in a state its customer may cancel: either already terminal, or past the free-cancellation point, after which cancelling carries fees (OD-08, OD-19).
codes.client_action: Refresh the job; offer support or a dispute rather than a retry.

codes.description: A required document expired; job acceptance blocked (PRD PR-14).
codes.client_action: Open the document renewal flow.

codes.description: Submit for review with a required step missing, rejected or expired; DETAIL lists the step kinds.
codes.client_action: Highlight the incomplete steps.

codes.description: Wrong input for the KYC step or an illegal step transition.
codes.client_action: Reload the KYC profile; the screen is stale.

codes.description: The offer TTL elapsed.
codes.client_action: Reload offers.

codes.description: The offer was accepted, declined, withdrawn or superseded meanwhile.
codes.client_action: Reload offers, for example: another provider was just selected.

codes.description: The negotiation thread reached its round limit.
codes.client_action: Offer only accept, decline or withdraw.

codes.description: The gateway reported the payment failed.
codes.client_action: Offer retry within the payment TTL.

codes.description: The payment window closed.
codes.client_action: Reload the job: it returned to negotiating or expired.

codes.description: The caller lacks the role the action needs. Used where refusing plainly is safe — the ops console — while participant-scoped reads answer *_NOT_FOUND instead, so an id cannot be probed.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message; do not retry.

codes.description: A sensitive admin action (approving a withdrawal, resolving a dispute, opening a KYC document, proposing or signing a configuration change) needs a TOTP code entered in the last five minutes. Read from the session's `amr`; `aal2` alone is not enough.
codes.client_action: Ask for a fresh code (`mfa.challengeAndVerify` on the same session), then retry with the same idempotency key.

codes.description: Amount above the category hard maximum for the country. The minimum viable payout check arrives with the commission rules (OD-06).
codes.client_action: Show the allowed range from the server response.

codes.description: The caller has a job of their own under way as a customer, so they cannot also go online to take work.
codes.client_action: Show the active job banner.

codes.description: A selfie check is due before going online (PRD PR-09).
codes.client_action: Launch the liveness session, then retry going online.

codes.description: The same person would be on both sides of a job.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message; never reveal the matching signal.

codes.description: No request with that id belongs to the signed-in customer.
codes.client_action: Refresh the list; it was cancelled, expired or never existed.

codes.description: The service category key is unknown or no longer active.
codes.client_action: Reload the catalogue from the bootstrap and pick again.

codes.description: Voice not available in this language (remote_config voice_languages).
codes.client_action: Fall back to the text concierge.

codes.description: A verification outcome was rejected; details are reason keys.
codes.client_action: Show the localized reason and the retry path.

codes.description: Publishing or paying needs customer verification (job lifecycle #2; review 2.14).
codes.client_action: Route to /verify/customer.

codes.description: Withdrawal under the per-currency minimum.
codes.client_action: Show the minimum from the country pack.

codes.description: App version below bootstrap min_supported_app_version.
codes.client_action: Blocking update screen (PRD SH-35).

codes.description: No response from the backend (offline, DNS, timeout).
codes.client_action: Show the offline state; retry with the same idempotency key.

codes.description: Mapped from Supabase Auth (auth-error-mapping.json).
codes.client_action: Let the user re-enter the code or resend.

codes.description: Mapped from Supabase Auth (auth-error-mapping.json).
codes.client_action: Show the retry-after time.

codes.description: An error the app cannot classify.
codes.client_action: Generic message; log with the request id.

codes.description: Vendor liveness or ID capture failed on the device.
codes.client_action: Show the retry path.

codes.description: No offer with that id is visible to the caller. Also returned when the caller is neither the customer nor the thread's provider, so an id cannot be probed.
codes.client_action: Refresh the thread.

codes.description: The same side may not counter or accept its own offer, and only the author may withdraw one.
codes.client_action: Show the thread's own actions; the counterparty has to answer first.

codes.description: The thread already has a live offer awaiting an answer.
codes.client_action: Counter or withdraw the live offer instead of sending a new one.

codes.description: The provider is serving a suspension; `suspended_until` says when it lifts.
codes.client_action: Show the suspension and its reason key; do not offer a retry.

codes.description: No city with that code in the caller's own country.
codes.client_action: Reload the city list for the country.

codes.description: The provider feed has nothing to measure distance from: no fresh position and no service area.
codes.client_action: Ask for location permission and send a heartbeat, or have the provider pick a service area.

codes.description: No job with that request id, or the caller is not its provider or worker. The same code covers both, so a job id cannot be probed.
codes.client_action: Refresh the job list.

codes.description: Too many wrong PINs for this job. A wrong PIN itself is not an error: `verify_pin` returns {verified: false, attempts_remaining}.
codes.client_action: Stop asking for the PIN; offer support or a dispute instead.

codes.description: Marking arrival from outside the pickup geofence without a reason code.
codes.client_action: Send the current position, or ask for a reason and send it with the call.

codes.description: The job cannot be completed until its required proof exists: every kind in the category's `proof_requirements` must have enough rows in `proofs`, and a job with a destination needs its delivery PIN verified. `DETAIL` names the kind and the count that is short.
codes.client_action: Send the provider to the outstanding proof step.

codes.description: A storage path was filed as proof but nothing was uploaded to it. The app uploads to the bucket first and files the path second; the server refuses a path with no object behind it, so a proof requirement cannot be met by a string (audit 2026-09-27 Y.5). meet_submit_photo raises it too when the photo or its thumbnail is not in the caller's meet-inbox folder.
codes.client_action: Upload the file again, then retry the same call with the same idempotency key.

codes.description: The ratings window for this job has closed (`ratings_window_hours`, 7 days by default).
codes.client_action: Hide the rating prompt; the job's reputation effect is settled.

codes.description: The chat window for this job is not open: it opens at assignment and closes a day after confirmation (`chat_window_hours_after_confirm`), except while a dispute is open.
codes.client_action: Hide the composer and say the conversation is closed; offer support.

codes.description: One of the two people has blocked the other. Symmetric, and the response never says which direction.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message. Never reveal that the other party blocked the caller, or offer to contact them another way.

codes.description: No organisation with that id is visible to the caller, or no membership row to act on.
codes.client_action: Refresh the organisation list.

codes.description: The action needs an organisation role the caller does not hold: owner for membership and vehicles, owner or dispatcher for dispatch, and self-accept enabled for a worker claiming a job.
codes.client_action: Hide the action for roles that do not have it rather than showing the error.

codes.description: The named worker is not an active member of the organisation, or is not verified and unsuspended as a provider in their own right (BU-04).
codes.client_action: Show the worker as unavailable with their verification state.

codes.description: The provider's vehicle type is banned in a zone covering the pickup (BU-09).
codes.client_action: Say which vehicle types the zone allows; the zone list is readable.

codes.description: Reserved, and not raised by the backend: `start_call` resolves a simultaneous attempt by returning the live call rather than refusing it, with `is_caller` telling the second caller they are now the callee (SH-12). Kept in case a call vendor forces a refusal instead.
codes.client_action: Do not expect it. On `start_call`, read `is_caller` and show answer or ring accordingly.

codes.description: The promo code is unknown, expired, already used, or not valid for this user or country.
codes.client_action: Show the reason next to the field and keep the order total unchanged.

codes.description: The user already has the maximum number of trusted contacts (`trusted_contacts_max`, five by default, SH-25).
codes.client_action: Ask them to remove one before adding another; show the list.

codes.description: No SOS incident with that id.
codes.client_action: Refresh the ops queue.

codes.description: That identity document is already registered to another account. One verified identity per person is a core anti-fraud control; the match is made on a blind index, so nothing reads either number.
codes.client_action: Show a neutral message and route to support. Never say whose account it is, or confirm that the number exists.

codes.description: The text names something the platform does not carry (`prohibited_items`, action `block`). Deterministic and explainable: `details` carries the rule key that fired. Only requests and Meet profile text (first name, bio, prompt answers, which pass the errands screen after the Meet one) are refused; errands chat and reviews are held for review instead (OD-21 fail-open).
codes.client_action: Name the rule from `details` and let them edit the text. Never retry the same text; a retry produces the same refusal.

codes.description: No moderation case with that id. Admin surfaces only.
codes.client_action: Refresh the moderation queue.

codes.description: No fraud flag with that id. Admin surfaces only; the subject of a flag can never read or reach one.
codes.client_action: Refresh the fraud queue.

codes.description: No call with that id.
codes.client_action: Close the call screen and return to the job.

codes.description: Calling is open from assignment until `chat_window_hours_after_confirm` after the job is confirmed, and stays open while a dispute is live (SH-12). Outside that window there is no call, and no PSTN fallback either.
codes.client_action: Hide the call button outside the window rather than letting it fail; if it fails anyway, say the job is over and offer support.

codes.description: Reserved for a telephony provider that exists and refuses — an exhausted number pool, or a country it does not cover. It is not raised today: `request_pstn_fallback` returns NULL when no number is allocated, because raising would roll back the `call.pstn_requested` event in the same transaction, and counting how often people reach for the phone is the only thing the seam is currently good for. No provider is contracted (REPORT §6.3).
codes.client_action: Treat a NULL return as “not available yet”: keep the user on the in-app call and do not retry in a loop. Handle this code the same way when a provider exists.

codes.description: No support ticket with that id, or it is not yours. Somebody else's ticket is not admitted to exist, so this is also the answer to reading one you do not own.
codes.client_action: Return to the ticket list and refresh.

codes.description: The ticket is closed and takes no further replies. A resolved ticket still does: replying reopens it.
codes.client_action: Offer to open a new ticket, and quote the old one.

codes.description: That user has no provider profile. Admin surfaces only.
codes.client_action: Refresh the user record.

codes.description: A ledger posting did not sum to zero, or had fewer than two entries. Raised by `ledger.post` before anything is written, and again by a deferred constraint trigger as the invariant of last resort (S-14). No client can reach the ledger, so this never surfaces in an app.
codes.client_action: Never expected. Treat as a money incident: stop the affected worker, do not retry, and reconcile before resuming.

codes.description: One ledger transaction mixed two currencies. A job is priced and settled in its own country's currency and there are no cross-currency jobs at launch, so this means a caller built the entries wrongly.
codes.client_action: Never expected; same handling as ERR_LEDGER_UNBALANCED.

codes.description: A ledger entry of zero. It records nothing and usually means an amount was computed as NULL or rounded away, so it is refused rather than stored.
codes.client_action: Never expected; fix the posting that produced it.

codes.description: No payment matches that id, or that gateway reference. Raised inside the webhook and settlement seams, which no client can reach.
codes.client_action: Never expected in an app. In a worker: the webhook names a charge we have no record of — store it, do not retry, and raise it with the gateway.

codes.description: No refund with that id, or it is not pending. Raised inside the gateway seams.
codes.client_action: Never expected in an app.

codes.description: Refunds against one payment would total more than was paid. A deferred constraint trigger, so it aborts the whole transaction and cannot be caught — anything issuing a partial refund must check first and raise its own error (S-14).
codes.client_action: Never expected. Treat as a money incident: stop the worker and reconcile before resuming.

codes.description: This job has no item float, so there is no receipt to file against it. Only a request created with `item_float_minor` has one.
codes.client_action: Do not show the receipt screen unless the job has a float.

codes.description: Nothing is paid through the app here: the request's country takes payment directly (countries.config.client.payment_mode = 'direct', ADR-0025), or the job was hired that way. Raised when a payment, tip, float top-up or dispute would be created.
codes.client_action: Do not show Pay, tips, promo codes or disputes when the country pack's payment_mode is 'direct'. Show Confirm hire, and send complaints to support.

codes.description: confirm_hire was called in a country that takes payment in the app. Only a direct-payment country hires without paying.
codes.client_action: Show Pay (start_payment) instead of Confirm hire; read payment_mode from the country pack.

codes.description: The goods recorded on a direct-payment job cost more than the cap the customer set on the request (item_float_minor).
codes.client_action: Tell the provider the customer agreed to at most the cap; they should agree a new cap with the customer in chat before buying more.

codes.description: Earnings cannot be recognised while the item float is still waiting on a receipt or its approval — settling around it would strand the goods money in a holding account nobody is watching. The settlement sweep skips the job and retries next run.
codes.client_action: Never surfaces in an app. A job stuck here for days means a receipt nobody approved; the auto-approval sweep should have cleared it.

codes.description: No dispute with that id, or not one you are party to. Somebody else's dispute is not admitted to exist.
codes.client_action: Return to the job and refresh.

codes.description: This job already has an open dispute. Two arguments about one job are one argument.
codes.client_action: Open the existing case instead of offering to start another.

codes.description: A dispute needs money still held against the job. Once it has settled or been paid out the remedy is a chargeback or a clawback, not a dispute.
codes.client_action: Hide the dispute button once the job has settled; route the user to support instead.

codes.description: No payout account with that id for this user, or it has not been verified with the bank yet. An unverified account is not somewhere money may be sent.
codes.client_action: Send them to add or re-verify a payout account. Show `verified_at` on the account list so the state is never a surprise.

codes.description: No payout with that id. Raised inside the gateway seam.
codes.client_action: Never expected in an app.

codes.description: No withdrawal with that id. Admin surfaces only.
codes.client_action: Refresh the approvals queue.

codes.description: A country pack names a payment provider that no adapter implements. Recorded on the outbox event as a permanent failure, because it is a configuration mistake and should look like one rather than like a gateway outage.
codes.client_action: Never reaches an app. Fix the country pack, or ship the adapter.

codes.description: A transfer or a bank name enquiry needs the real account number, and `payout_accounts.account_ciphertext` is envelope-encrypted with a KMS key the worker does not have (ADR-0007; GCP billing is timeline action 1). The event is handed back for retry rather than failed, so it is still waiting when the key arrives.
codes.client_action: Never reaches an app. It means payouts are paused, not lost.

codes.description: No referral code matches what was entered, or it is not a well-formed one. Codes are eight characters from an alphabet with no letter that reads as a digit.
codes.client_action: Show a field error and let them retype it, or paste from the share link.

codes.description: This account already has a referrer. One referrer per account, for ever — the attribution is what makes the programme single-level.
codes.client_action: Show who introduced them and hide the code field.

codes.description: Somebody entered their own referral code. The other self-referral case — two accounts on one handset — is not refused here: it is accepted and blocked silently, so that nobody learns which signal caught them.
codes.client_action: Show a field error.

codes.description: A referral code may only be entered before the account's first errand (spec referral_program).
codes.client_action: Explain that codes are entered at sign-up, and hide the field.

codes.description: No configuration change with that id. Admin surface only.
codes.client_action: Refresh the approvals queue.

codes.description: A country cannot go live while its pack is missing something the running system reads — cities, published terms and privacy, accepted ID types, SMS providers, payment providers, payout providers, or a payment route that is only the development provider. DETAIL names what is missing.
codes.client_action: Show the gaps from country_pack_readiness; the change stays pending until they are filled.

codes.description: A chargeback arrived on a payment that has already been refunded, or on a job with an item float. The customer has been paid twice and which of the two to unwind is a person's decision, not arithmetic.
codes.client_action: Internal: the webhook is acknowledged and the case goes to finance. No client surface.

codes.description: A business with that registration number is already on the platform in this country. Matched on a blind index, so nothing reads either number.
codes.client_action: Say the number is already registered and route to support. Never say which business holds it.

codes.description: No organisation with that id. Admin surface only.
codes.client_action: Refresh the business list.

codes.description: A worker was handed a money operation whose amount is zero or negative - a refund of nothing, for example. Not retried: it is a row somebody should look at, not a call to a gateway.
codes.client_action: Internal: recorded on the outbox event as a permanent failure.

codes.description: Every channel a notification was decided for failed to send, so the outbox event is retried. One channel succeeding is enough to complete it - retrying then would re-send the one that worked.
codes.client_action: Internal: recorded on the outbox event. The inbox row exists either way, so the app is not missing anything.

codes.description: A notification's outbox event was older than notifications.push_max_age_minutes (120 by default) when the dispatcher reached it, so its push, SMS or email was dropped rather than delivered late.
codes.client_action: Internal: recorded on the outbox event. The inbox row still exists, so the app shows the notification; only the late push is skipped.

codes.description: An outbox event of a type its aggregate's worker does not handle. Failed, not completed, so it stays visible: an event nobody handles is how a refund once went missing (audit T.2).
codes.client_action: Ops: find the emitter and give the event a reader.

codes.description: The Storage API refused or failed a list, remove, download or upload: during erasure (storage-worker, storage.erase_prefix and storage.erase_object) or while meet-media-worker moved a photo, or the database did not answer its report. Retried; nothing is erased or reported until it succeeds (audit 2026-09-27 Y.30).
codes.client_action: Ops, if retries exhaust: RB-12 and the storage-worker logs.

codes.description: The user already has the maximum number of saved places (`saved_places_max`, twenty by default).
codes.client_action: Ask them to remove one before saving another; show the list.

codes.description: No saved place with that id belongs to the caller.
codes.client_action: Reload the saved places list.

codes.description: A field-encryption key is missing: the Vault KEK entry named in `private.field_keks`, or the data key for the record class (ADR-0018). An operations fault, never a user one (RB-16).
codes.client_action: Never expected. Show the generic error; the operation did not happen.

codes.description: A sealed field failed its integrity check: altered, truncated, or moved to a row it was not sealed for (ADR-0018). Only these functions write ciphertext, so this is a security incident, not a bug to retry.
codes.client_action: Never expected; treat as a security incident (RB-16).

codes.description: This job already has a float top-up. One per job, by design: a declined request cannot be repeated (OD-04).
codes.client_action: Show the existing top-up and its status. If it was declined or expired, offer the dispute path for the difference.

codes.description: The receipt is further above the prepaid float than a top-up may cover (`float_top_up_max_bps`, 100% of the float by default).
codes.client_action: Tell the provider this gap cannot be a top-up: file the receipt for the float and open a dispute for the rest.

codes.description: No float top-up with that id belongs to one of the caller's requests.
codes.client_action: Reload the job; the top-up may have been settled or withdrawn.

codes.description: `set_initial_country` was asked for a different country than the one the profile already has. The country is chosen once.
codes.client_action: Do not offer the country step again; refresh the profile.

codes.description: The profile has no country yet (a Google or Apple sign-up that skipped the country step). Also raised by private.meet_require_access, the check at the top of every Meet v5 client RPC, which the per-RPC error lists in the catalogue do not show.
codes.client_action: Send the person to the country step, then retry.

codes.description: No meet-up with that id is visible to the caller: missing, in another country, blocked, or not theirs to cancel.
codes.client_action: Show not found and return to the meet-up list.

codes.description: Every place on the meet-up is taken.
codes.client_action: Say it is full; the person can try again later if someone leaves.

codes.description: The meet-up has started, ended or been cancelled.
codes.client_action: Say it is closed and refresh it.

codes.description: The host already has `meetup_max_active_hosted` upcoming meet-ups.
codes.client_action: Explain the limit; suggest cancelling one first.

codes.description: Start less than 30 minutes or more than 90 days ahead, or longer than 24 hours.
codes.client_action: Point at the time fields with the rule.

codes.description: The caller has not passed Meet's 18+ check-in (meet_check_in), so no Meet feature is open to them. Raised by private.meet_require_access, which every Meet v5 client RPC calls first; the generated per-RPC error lists omit it. An account refused as under 18, or on a barred device, gets ERR_MEET_UNAVAILABLE instead.
codes.client_action: Send the person to the Meet welcome and check-in screen.

codes.description: Produced by the apps, never raised: meet_check_in returns {status: 'refused'} for somebody under 18, because the refusal is recorded and a raise would roll the record back (design D24).
codes.client_action: Show the under-18 screen and the way back to errands. Do not offer to re-enter the date.

codes.description: Meet is not available on this account or device: an earlier under-18 refusal on the account, a device barred after an under-18 refusal on any account (meet_age_refusal_devices, 365 days) or, from M1-PR4, a ban, or failed device integrity at check-in. Indistinguishable on purpose. Raised by private.meet_require_access, the check at the top of every Meet v5 client RPC (so not in the per-RPC lists); meet_check_in returns {status: 'unavailable'} instead of raising, because it records a safety event, and it gives that answer for every date on a barred or failing phone, an under-18 one included (which it still records). The ways out are not refused with it: meet_pause(true), meet_set_discoverable(false), meet_set_privacy, meet_remove_photo, meet_remove_prompt and meet_delete_profile. Somebody refused this way is shown to nobody and reads nobody's photos.
codes.client_action: Show that Meet is not available and point to support; never say why.

codes.description: The birth date is set once. A second meet_check_in is refused; corrections go through support and admin_meet_correct_birth_date.
codes.client_action: Refresh meet_get_state and continue from where it says the person is.

codes.description: The Meet guidelines changed (remote_config meet.guidelines_version) and the caller has not accepted the current version. Raised by private.meet_require_access before any other Meet function runs (so not in the per-RPC lists), and by meet_check_in and meet_accept_guidelines when the version passed is not the current one. The ways out (meet_pause(true), meet_set_discoverable(false), meet_set_privacy, meet_remove_photo, meet_remove_prompt, meet_delete_profile) do not raise it. Until they accept, the person is shown to nobody and reads nobody's photos.
codes.client_action: Show the guidelines and call meet_accept_guidelines with the version shown, then retry.

codes.description: The caller is suspended from Meet. The safety functions (report, block, unblock, the blocked list) stay open.
codes.client_action: Show the suspension screen with its end date from meet_get_state; keep the safety centre reachable.

codes.description: A temporary restriction on one scope (messages, new conversations, likes, statuses), for example after three contact-filter strikes in 24 hours. A rate limit, not a ban.
codes.client_action: Disable the action and show when it reopens (meet_get_state restrictions).

codes.description: Too many of one action in a short window: messages per minute, reports per day, or moving the Meet area more often than every 6 hours.
codes.client_action: Ask the person to wait and try again later.

codes.description: Today's allowance for this action is used up (likes, winks, pokes, new conversations, game rounds). It resets at the caller's local midnight.
codes.client_action: Show the limit and when it resets.

codes.description: No Meet profile with that id is visible to the caller: missing, paused, held, suspended, or blocked either way. Indistinguishable on purpose, so there is no oracle.
codes.client_action: Show not found and go back.

codes.description: The action needs an active Meet profile (a clean first name and bio, at least one approved photo, an area): browsing, and turning discovery on. An edit that needs a profile to exist (a photo, a prompt, the area, pause, privacy) raises it when there is none yet. Raised by private.meet_require_access where the function needs an active profile, so not always in the per-RPC lists.
codes.client_action: Send the person to finish their profile; while the first photo is in review show today's question.

codes.description: Six photos at most (remote_config meet.photos.max, counting those processing, in review and approved), or that position already holds one; the detail says 'position taken' for the second. A position whose photo was rejected or failed is free: submitting there replaces it.
codes.client_action: Ask the person to remove or replace a photo first.

codes.description: No photo with that id belongs to the caller.
codes.client_action: Refresh meet_get_my_profile.

codes.description: Profile text (first name, bio, prompt, status, game answer) contains a phone number, email, link or social handle. Nothing is written. A chat refusal is a returned status instead, never this error. From M1-PR3 for first name, bio and prompt answers (table triggers on meet_profiles and meet_prompts, so on every write path); statuses and game answers from M1-PR7. Until M1-PR4 the screen catches digit runs of seven or more (any character that is not a letter or a digit may sit between the digits), emails and links, after removing every invisible (default-ignorable) character; handles and number words arrive with it.
codes.client_action: Keep the text and show the category message; never highlight the matched words.

codes.description: Profile text asks for money or gifts, or offers paid company. Nothing is written. A chat refusal is a returned status instead. From M1-PR3 for first name, bio and prompt answers, against the terms design §8.2 blocks everywhere; M1-PR4 moves them into meet_text_rules.
codes.client_action: Keep the text and show the category message.

codes.description: No open match with that id includes the caller: expired, unmatched, closed by a block or a moderation decision, or never theirs.
codes.client_action: Remove the match from the list and refresh meet_matches.

codes.description: No Meet conversation with that id includes the caller.
codes.client_action: Go back to the chat list and refresh it.

codes.description: The conversation is closed: the match expired, somebody unmatched or blocked, or a moderation decision closed it. The reason is not given.
codes.client_action: Show the conversation as closed and disable the composer.

codes.description: No status with that id is visible to the caller, or the caller is not its poster.
codes.client_action: Close the status viewer and refresh the ring.

codes.description: Too many statuses today (remote_config meet.status.max_per_day).
codes.client_action: Show the limit and when it resets.

codes.description: The action needs a photo-verified profile, for example a photo status.
codes.client_action: Offer photo verification.

codes.description: No verification attempt with that id belongs to the caller, or its pose has expired.
codes.client_action: Start a new verification with meet_verification_pose.

codes.description: The action needs a higher card tier than the caller holds (remote_config meet.status.post_min_card, game and privacy perks).
codes.client_action: Explain what unlocks it.

codes.description: No game round with that id belongs to a conversation the caller is in.
codes.client_action: Refresh the conversation.

codes.description: The game round has been revealed or has expired.
codes.client_action: Show the round's final state from meet_get_round.

codes.description: Staff: no Meet report with that id is in the caller's scope.
codes.client_action: Refresh the report queue.

codes.description: Staff: no Meet suspension with that id is in the caller's scope, or a meet moderator is lifting one they may not.
codes.client_action: Refresh the person's Meet summary.

codes.description: A guarded Meet flag was switched on beyond what the readiness checklist allows (design D23): meet.v5 for anybody but testers before every m1 item is done, or meet.purchases / meet.vip before the m2_testers (testers-only) or m2 items are. Raised by the trigger on feature_flags, so it catches a review_config_change apply too, which leaves the proposal pending. The detail lists the missing items. Only a widening is checked: switching a flag off is never refused, and nor is a change to a flag already on that admits nobody new (a lower rollout_pct, back to testers-only, a client_visible edit).
codes.client_action: Console: show the missing items from the detail and the /meet/readiness checklist; keep the proposal for when they are done.
